method: O0/O2 direct GNU Fortran runtime measurement with per-run process-evaluation counters and payload sizes from allocated array extents; production physics and solver tolerances unchanged
scope: same-node-count serialized BASE inactive-option replay versus admitted PPA-WU04A Black, PPA-WU04B Boesten, and the restricted F-MR39 soil-temperature runtime fixture; external common parameter/state/forcing arrays, runtime common solver/work arrays, option input payloads, and exact process-call counts

workload.base: three-column serialized A-B-A batch with BASE state/parameter/forcing layouts; Black, Boesten, snow and restricted soil-temperature allocatable payloads are asserted absent
workload.black: admitted WU04A Black production-application profile plus one direct full/half backend trial used to inspect exact option evaluation-call count
workload.boesten: admitted WU04B Boesten production-application profile plus one direct full/half backend trial used to inspect exact option evaluation-call count
workload.soil_temperature: pinned F-MR39 enabled water/thermal runtime fixture, replayed against the measured source postimage with temporary test-only batch-counter output; no change to the pinned donor test source or feature qualification claim

measured_payload_bytes.accounting_note: Byte totals use element storage_size multiplied by actual allocated array extents, plus existing Richards and A23BU workspace payload counters. They exclude Fortran allocation descriptors, allocator metadata/alignment, fixed backend record storage, automatic stack temporaries and transient high-water buffers cleared before observation.

tests: pinned F-MR39 runtime donor test, instrumented only in a temporary generated copy for measurement
additional_checks: BASE optional parameter, forcing and physical-state payloads are absent
BASE option-specific process-call counters remain zero across all three columns
BASE and Black common parameter/state/forcing payloads and serialized common workspace bytes match
Black and Boesten each evaluated exactly three times for their direct full/half trial
restricted soil-temperature fixture evaluated three times and used 640 bytes of optional parameter/workspace array payload
soil-temperature probe was deterministic across repeated runs and O0/O2; original pinned donor source was not modified
the WU04A production application retains its existing hard-mass, retry, restart and layout-guard gates

remaining_gap: Runtime active/inactive measurement covers BASE versus Black and Boesten, plus one restricted soil-temperature runtime fixture. Runtime option calls and payloads for active snow and drainage response, other optional-state compositions, fixed descriptors, allocator overhead and transient peak memory are not measured by this checkpoint.
next_action: Extend the same counters and payload census to active snow and drainage-response cases only where their qualification prerequisites permit; otherwise record the precise upstream admission limitation and proceed to another open M7 criterion. Do not treat zero counters in inactive profiles as qualification of an active option.
